content: Hi, how can i assist you today?
CAPTCHAs keep showing letters of my initials. It feels like the site is addressing me.
CAPTCHA text is usually random within a character set. How many challenges did you complete, and in how many did all initials appear?
Maybe 15 challenges; I remember 4 with at least two of my initials.
Two letters overlapping with common initials can occur. A small tally over more challenges would show the base rate of partial matches versus total attempts.
I can count for the next week.
Keeping screenshots with timestamps lets you verify the character distribution later without relying on memory.
I’ll save a few examples and the misses too.
Including both cases gives a balanced view of how often initials appear relative to all characters shown.
